classification_requires: fresh parent run still reports in_progress
one or more child jobs exist
every paginated child job reports completed
every child job has a valid completed_at timestamp
latest child completion is at least 30 minutes old
parent run metadata has not updated for at least 30 minutes
hard_exclusions: any child job is queued, waiting, pending, requested, or in_progress
parent or child timestamps are invalid or too recent

recovery.on_second_http_409: record unresolved platform state and stop mutating that run
